name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person across every product and market, worst first. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Regulator deadlines
sections.note: Reports past due or due within three days, serious cases with no assessment, follow-ups and safety issues owed to the regulator.
sections.sql: select item, rule, detail, days from safety_attention where severity = 1 order by days desc nulls last, item

sections.title: Overdue work
sections.sql: select item, rule, detail, days from safety_attention where severity = 2 order by days desc nulls last, item

sections.title: Housekeeping
sections.sql: select item, rule, detail, days from safety_attention where severity = 3 order by days desc nulls last, item

name: clock
title: The reporting clock
subtitle: Every reportable case not yet lodged, soonest deadline first, and the follow-ups that need their own report.

sections.title: Cases on the clock
sections.sql: select code as case, product, regulator, replace(trigger, '_', ' ') as rule, day_zero, due_on, days_left, coalesce(causality, 'NOT ASSESSED') as causality from case_clock where status = 'open' and reportable and submitted_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Follow-up answers owed to the regulator
sections.sql: select code as followup, case_code as case, regulator, received_on, report_due, report_due - current_date as days_left from followup_clock where report_due is not null and reported_on is null order by report_due

sections.title: Safety issues owed to the regulator
sections.sql: select code as issue, product, upper(kind) as kind, title, aware_on, due_on from issue_clock where kind in ('ssi','osi') and reported_on is null order by due_on

name: signals
title: Signals
subtitle: Reaction terms the label does not list, counted by ingredient, and the safety issues already open.

sections.title: Unlisted reactions in the last 90 days
sections.sql: select ingredient, term, count(*)::int as cases, string_agg(distinct case_code, ', ') as case_codes from reaction_check where not expected and received_on >= current_date - 90 group by ingredient, term order by count(*) desc, ingredient, term

sections.title: Open signals and safety issues
sections.sql: select code, product, title, kind, opened_on, days_open, due_on from issue_clock where status = 'open' order by opened_on
